name: Hyper stored superbounce: a hyper, then the carried wall coyote as a dash boost
techNote: The stored-superbounce lab's post and floor with the omnidash. Hold down-left: the cling slides the dot onto the floor (wallCoyoteFrames 7 kept, it doesn't count down on the ground). Hop, dash down-right on the next tick with jump on dash frame 4: the landing turns the dash flat and the hyper fires on tick 19 (framesSinceLastDash 4: 547 up, 1650 momentum right). Press jump again on the next tick (framesSinceLastDash 5, inside dashBoostMax 6): the stored count (wallCoyoteFrames 5) makes it a wall jump off no wall with the dash boost, SpecialWallJump(0.6, 0.6, up * 410): Velocity (-276, 730) plus 401 momentum up on top of the hyper's 1570 right. It peaks at y 489 (x 1319) and is in the finish box (x 1220-1420, y 440-500) on tick 51. One tick later (the jump on dash frame 5, the press at framesSinceLastDash 6) it is a plain stored wall jump and peaks at 300; the hyper alone 200; the stored superbounce (a super) is at y 190 at x 1200.

ghosts.label: One tick late: stored wall jump
